author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: অনুচ্ছেদটি পড়ে সঠিক উত্তরটি বেছে নাও (Board: reading MCQ)।

items.passage: The Sundarbans is the largest mangrove forest in the world. It is situated in the south-western part of Bangladesh. It is the home of the Royal Bengal Tiger. Many other animals such as deer, monkeys and crocodiles also live there. The forest protects the coastal areas from cyclones and tidal waves.

subs.q: What is the Sundarbans?
subs.rule_bn: 'the largest mangrove forest in the world'।

subs.q: Where is the Sundarbans situated?
The Sundarbans is the home of the ___.
subs.rule_bn: 'the home of the Royal Bengal Tiger'।

subs.q: What does the forest protect the coastal areas from?
subs.rule_bn: 'protects the coastal areas from cyclones and tidal waves'।

items.passage: Honey is a sweet and healthy food. It is made by bees. Bees collect nectar from flowers and store it in their hives. Honey is used as both food and medicine. It gives us energy and helps to cure many diseases. That is why honey is very valuable to us.

subs.q: Who makes honey?
From where do bees collect nectar?
Honey is used as food and ___.
What does honey give us?

items.passage: Rabindranath Tagore was a great poet. He was born in Kolkata in 1861. He wrote poems, songs, novels and dramas. His famous book of poems is Gitanjali. In 1913 he won the Nobel Prize for this book. He was the first Asian to win this prize.

subs.q: When was Tagore born?
What is Tagore's famous book of poems?
subs.rule_bn: 'His famous book of poems is Gitanjali'।

subs.q: In which year did he win the Nobel Prize?
Tagore was the first ___ to win the Nobel Prize.
subs.rule_bn: 'the first Asian to win this prize'।

items.passage: The frog lives both on land and in water. It is an amphibian. It has smooth, wet skin and long back legs. It eats insects and worms. The frog catches its food with its long sticky tongue. It sleeps in the mud during the cold winter months.

subs.q: Where does the frog live?
opts: both on land and in water
subs.rule_bn: 'lives both on land and in water'।

subs.q: What is a frog called?
What does the frog eat?
With what does it catch food?

items.passage: Air is very important for all living beings. We cannot live without air even for a few minutes. Air is a mixture of many gases. Oxygen is the most important gas in the air. We take in oxygen when we breathe. But the air is becoming polluted by smoke and dust.

subs.q: How long can we live without air?
subs.rule_bn: 'cannot live without air even for a few minutes'।

subs.q: Air is a mixture of ___.
subs.rule_bn: 'Air is a mixture of many gases'।

subs.q: Which is the most important gas in the air?
By what is the air being polluted?

items.passage: The Shaheed Minar is a symbol of our language movement. It was built in memory of the language martyrs of 1952. On the 21st of February people place flowers at the Shaheed Minar. They come barefoot early in the morning to show respect. The day is now observed as International Mother Language Day.

subs.q: What is the Shaheed Minar a symbol of?
In whose memory was it built?
subs.rule_bn: 'in memory of the language martyrs of 1952'।

subs.q: What do people place at the Shaheed Minar?
The day is observed as ___.

items.passage: The elephant is the largest land animal. It has a huge body, four thick legs and a long trunk. It uses its trunk to take food and water. Though it is very big, it eats only plants and leaves. Elephants are used to carry heavy loads and logs.

subs.q: The elephant is the largest ___ animal.
What does the elephant use to take food?
subs.rule_bn: 'uses its trunk to take food and water'।

subs.q: What does the elephant eat?
For what are elephants used?
subs.rule_bn: 'used to carry heavy loads and logs'।

items.passage: Exercise is good for our health. It makes our muscles strong. It also helps the blood to flow well in our body. People who exercise regularly seldom fall ill. Morning is the best time for exercise, because the air is fresh then.

subs.q: What is good for our health?
What does exercise make strong?
People who exercise regularly ___.
Which is the best time for exercise?
subs.rule_bn: 'Morning is the best time for exercise'।

items.passage: The Taj Mahal is a wonderful monument in India. It is situated at Agra on the bank of the river Jamuna. It was built by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz. It is made of white marble. Millions of tourists come to see it every year.

subs.q: Where is the Taj Mahal situated?
Who built the Taj Mahal?
subs.rule_bn: 'built by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan'।

subs.q: In whose memory was it built?
What is the Taj Mahal made of?

items.passage: A library is a storehouse of knowledge. It is a place where many books are kept for reading. Students read different kinds of books there. A library is a calm and quiet place. We should keep silent in the library so that others can read attentively.

subs.q: A library is a storehouse of ___.
What are kept in a library?
What kind of place is a library?
What should we do in the library?

items.passage: The cuckoo is a bird of sweet voice. It is black in colour and looks like a crow. It is a lazy bird and builds no nest of its own. It lays its eggs in the crow's nest. The cuckoo sings sweetly in spring.

subs.q: What is the cuckoo famous for?
What is the colour of the cuckoo?
Where does the cuckoo lay its eggs?
subs.rule_bn: 'lays its eggs in the crow's nest'।

subs.q: When does the cuckoo sing sweetly?

items.passage: Rice is our main food. It grows well in wet and low land. Farmers work hard in the field to grow rice. They plough the land, sow the seeds and give water. When the crop becomes ripe, they cut it. Rice gives us energy to work.

subs.q: What is our main food?
Where does rice grow well?
subs.rule_bn: 'grows well in wet and low land'।

subs.q: Who work hard to grow rice?
What does rice give us?

items.passage: The sun is the source of all energy. It rises in the east and sets in the west. It gives us light and heat. Without the sun there would be no life on earth. Plants make their food with the help of sunlight.

subs.q: What is the sun the source of?
Where does the sun rise?
What does the sun give us?
With whose help do plants make food?
subs.rule_bn: 'make their food with the help of sunlight'।

items.passage: Ants are small but hardworking insects. They live together in colonies. They work all day to collect food. In summer they store food for the winter. Ants teach us the lesson of industry and unity.

subs.q: What kind of insects are ants?
How do ants live?
When do ants store food?
What lesson do ants teach us?
subs.rule_bn: 'teach us the lesson of industry and unity'।

items.passage: Dr Muhammad Yunus is a famous economist of Bangladesh. He founded the Grameen Bank for the poor. This bank gives small loans to poor people, especially women. In 2006 he won the Nobel Prize for Peace. He is honoured all over the world.

subs.q: What is Dr Yunus famous as?
What bank did he found?
To whom does the bank give small loans?
subs.rule_bn: 'small loans to poor people, especially women'।

subs.q: In which year did he win the Nobel Prize?

items.passage: Trees are called the lungs of nature. They take in carbon dioxide and give out oxygen. They keep the air fresh and cool. Trees also give shelter to birds and animals. If we cut down trees, the balance of nature will be destroyed.

subs.q: Trees are called the ___ of nature.
What do trees give out?
To whom do trees give shelter?
What will be destroyed if we cut trees?
subs.rule_bn: 'the balance of nature will be destroyed'।
